                       + (1/2)(U^T u)^T S(U^T u).

Here U is a fixed, full-column-rank n-by-r map describing actual accessible attachment coordinates q=U^T u. The support has S>=0, a common zero rest coordinate, and no state-dependent chemistry, preload, change of f_s, or change of H. Any stable modes retained at a transition state are constrained modes: this is not a Gaussian integration over an unstable saddle direction. The constrained ensembles and their measures are fixed. Temperature T>0 is common and classical. Reservoir driving is a separate paid boundary.

    G=U^T H^-1 U >0,       p_s=U^T H^-1 f_s,

    Q=I-(I+L)^-1.

    S=G^-1/2 [(I-Q)^-1-I] G^-1/2.                    (1)

## 1. Exact domain and accounting boundary

Let I be a finite set of operational states. A transition event t from i either reaches another operational state j or an absorbing failure label D_alpha. Multiple events can connect the same ordered state pair; keep their labels when their reservoir, damage mechanism, reward or stiffness response differs. Every operational state is transient: absorption occurs almost surely. Rates are finite and positive on the fixed retained event set. Fix an initial distribution rho, independent of the control, and a fixed per-event reward g_it. Failure events may carry fixed terminal/inventory settlement rewards; otherwise their reward is zero. There is no separate continuously accrued reward and no finite laboratory-time cutoff in the first theorem.

For the row-generator convention, Q_ij=sum_t:i->j k_it for i != j and Q_ii=-sum_all outgoing t k_it. Absorbing-state values are zero. Put r_i=sum_t k_it g_it. Then

    v=(-Q)^(-1) r,      Y=rho^T v,
    nu^T=rho^T(-Q)^(-1),      tau=rho^T(-Q)^(-1) 1.

Here v_i is expected cumulative reward starting in i, nu_i is expected time spent in i before failure, and tau is mean lifetime. Finite transient state space with finite rates and almost-sure absorption makes the relevant fundamental matrix finite. Alternatively the formulas apply whenever its inverse and reward expectations exist. Signed rewards are allowed; a positive technological endpoint still needs an explicit accepted-output definition.

Net right-port counting, with right entry -1 and right exit +1, is different from gross exits. A finite-life pore may retain or lose its last ion. Terminal inventory and its free energy must be accounted for before interpreting particle count as useful transport or work. In particular, zero stationary equilibrium current does not imply that every failure-stopped signed count is zero.

## 1. What the incoming equations establish

Source lines 37–107 specify stable host coordinates, common K≻0 and masses, classical harmonic ensembles, a physically accessible common clamp, and fixed constrained state meanings. Completing the square and applying the rank-one inverse and determinant identities gives

    ΔF_s=χR_s+(kBT/2)log(1+κc),
    ΔB_s=χ(R_s−R_A),
    c=bᵀK⁻¹b, R_s=(bᵀK⁻¹f_s)²/(2c), χ=κc/(1+κc).

The determinant term cancels only because K is common. The source's R_U<R_A<R_H criterion correctly lowers the useful barrier and raises the harmful barrier under one control. Unchanged kinetic prefactors, entry transition states, recrossing, dividing surfaces and equilibration separation are additional model premises. Mere passivity of the added spring establishes none of the state-overlap ordering.

With rates a_L,a_R for entry, b_L,b_R for exit, let A=a_L+a_R, B=b_L+b_R and Δ=a_Lb_R−a_Rb_L. The two-state occupancy calculation gives J=Δ/(A+B). Under the source's shared entry/exit transition assumption,

    a′=αa, b′=qb,
    α=exp(−βχR_U), q=exp[βχ(R_A−R_U)],
    J′/J=αq(A+B)/(αA+qB),

provided J≠0. The affinity is unchanged. For q>1 and α<1 the current gain condition is exactly the source's loading threshold A/B>q(1−α)/[α(q−1)]. An enhanced escape rate is therefore insufficient for current gain.

## 2. Exact yield cancellation under occupied-only damage

Assume all rates are time-homogeneous, the pore is empty initially, a destructive absorbing transition of rate h>0 occurs only while occupied, and N counts right exits minus right entries up to failure. Solve the backward first-step equations. If π_R=a_R/A, then

    E T=(A+B+h)/(Ah),
    E N=Δ/(Ah)−π_R.

With h′=q_Hh and q_H=exp[βχ(R_A−R_H)], substitution gives the exact identity

    E N′+π_R=(q/q_H)(E N+π_R),
